The '''Second Battalion''' was a unit in the [[Fifth Infantry]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The battalion's [[Aurek Company (Second Battalion)|Aurek]], [[Besh Company|Besh]], and [[Cresh Company|Cresh Companies]] were stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tyrus (Sobrik)|Tyrus]].
